The new value cites the Introduction cost O(N M log(M) eps^-3 kappa^2), but Section IV, p.5, gives O(N M log(M) eps^-5 kappa^2 log(1/delta)). Either way the claim is the authors' asymptotic claim with no measured runtime, so LOW. Store the cost discrepancy as its own assertion.
